policies.sentence: Students should ask the instructor or staff when unsure whether an AI use is allowed.
Students should ask before using a specific tool, source or app that may be AI.
Students should ask the instructor before using AI they think is appropriate.
Students should get help from instructors and course staff rather than from AI.
Students are not penalized for asking about the accuracy of LLM output on course platforms.
The instructor invites students to reach out with questions or when stuck.
Students may tell staff if the policy disallows something that should be allowed.
